title: Keep the first value even when falsy
prompt: Write `firstOr<T>(items: T[], fallback: T): T`. Return the first item when `items` is not empty, and `fallback` when it is. The first item can be `0`, `""` or `null`, and must still be returned.
hints: How can you tell an empty array from one whose first item is `0`?
`||` and `??` both replace some real values.

wrongAnswers.misconception: Uses `||`, so a first item of 0 is replaced.
Uses `??`, so a first item of `null` is replaced.

feedback: How can you tell an empty array from one whose first item is `0`?
